description: This file implements the frontend of a Tic Tac Toe game using React, including game logic, UI components, styling, and user interactions.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner ('X' or 'O') based on the current board state and the winning line if any.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current game status message, including which player's turn it is, or if there's a winner or draw.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component managing the game state and rendering the game interface.
